title: Incident Handoff & Alerting UX: SLO-bound Alerts, On-call Handoff Modal, Postmortem Links
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Design a cohesive console experience for alert creation (SLO-aware), on-call handoff, and post-incident navigation. This ticket covers: 1) an alert setup wizard that can bind alerts to existing SLOs and surface expected noise/false-positive risk; 2) an on-call handoff modal that surfaces context (current active incidents, recent errors, suggested runbooks, relevant dashboard links, and a quick 'create postmortem' link); 3) a persistent incident header that links to postmortem drafts and external docs (Confluence/GDrive) and shows ownership history for audits.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Designer handoff includes Figma screens for: alert-wizard (SLO binding step), on-call handoff modal, incident header with postmortem link. 2) Prototype demonstrates flow: from alert firing to on-call handoff to postmortem creation link. 3) PM/Eng review signoff on edge cases (multiple SLOs bound, missing runbook, cross-region incidents). 4) Accessibility: all interactive controls keyboard-focusable and labeled. 5) UX copy provided for all flows and included in the prototype. 6) Implementation tickets created for frontend and backend behaviors with clear props/events documented.
design_notes: Design decisions so far: - Make SLO binding first-class during alert creation: show SLO burn-rate and 30d error rate to help users pick thresholds. - When an alert is bound to an SLO, surface 'suggested thresholds' derived from SLO budget and recent latency/error distributions. - The on-call handoff modal is lightweight: it's a single-step modal with collapsible sections (Summary, Recent Events, Suggested Runbooks, Links). We include 'Start Handoff' and 'Mark Acknowledged' actions. - Postmortem link behavior: when a user clicks 'Create Postmortem' we open a modal prefilled with incident metadata and a link to a Confluence template (or create in Drive for customers using Drive integration). - Keep primary incident flows in the Console (no forced external redirects) but provide clear external doc links for audit/storage. - Provide ability for an outgoing on-call to append a short context note to the postmortem draft directly from handoff modal.
open_questions: 1) Backend: can we reliably prefill postmortem drafts via API for customers on Private? (ping ENG-2110). 2) How should we represent multiple on-call rotations for one incident (first responder + secondary) in the header? 3) Should we allow templated severity-to-threshold suggestions per customer? 4) Do we show raw logs or a curated 'breadcrumbs' snapshot in the handoff modal?
comments: 2026-03-02 — Ava Martinez: First draft posted to Figma. Focused on minimizing cognitive load during handoff. Flagging ENG-2110 for backend prefill capability.

2026-03-08 — Priya Kapoor (PM): Requested adding 'notify rotation' checkbox to handoff modal so outgoing can trigger a dispatch to PagerDuty. Also asked for audit log entry on handoff. Marked customer_impact as high.

next_steps: 1) Iterate on Figma after today’s design review and incorporate SRE feedback (banner for depleted SLO). 2) Create two engineering tickets: frontend - DES->ENG mapping for components + props; backend - API surface for postmortem prefill and runbook lookup. 3) Schedule usability session with three on-call engineers to validate handoff modal content. 4) Finalize copy and accessibility checks before handoff to implementation.
